'''Morbiss''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] who operated at some point around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Morbiss was based on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and he had enemies throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and he employed a large retinue of thugs to protect him from his rivals. However, while on a visit to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to [[Gambling/Legends|bet]] on the world's [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]], an opponent of Morbiss detonated a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] aboard the Hutt's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], resulting in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the slaver.
